name: Tyson Foods Springdale Complex - Springdale AR

citations.claim: Tyson monument sign on a brick base at the Jefferson St entrance reading 'Tyson - MAIN/VISITOR ENTRANCE / SHIPPING / SOUTH TEAM MEMBER PARKING'; Tyson-liveried reefer trailers parked behind it. Pano captured 2025-03.
'Tyson Foods Inc.', primaryType manufacturer, 600 Berry St, Springdale, AR 72764 at 36.190375,-94.125687 - the parcel imaged.

verification.rationale: Session WebSearch budget was exhausted, so no Tier-1 documentary check (10-K Item 2, careers reqs) was run; identity was established from 2025-03 on-property Tyson signage, Tyson-branded equipment in the yard, and the Google Places business record. Springdale is Tyson's headquarters town and this is its original processing complex - divestiture risk is low but was not affirmatively checked. Divestiture/closure gauntlet run 2026-08-12: this site was checked by name against Tyson's announced closures 2023-2026 and does not appear on that list.

divestitureCitation.claim: Tyson closure sweep 2023-2026 checked this site by name against the announced-closure list (2023 poultry: Noel MO, Corydon IN, Glen Allen VA, Van Buren AR; 2024: Perry IA pork, North Little Rock AR; 2025: Emporia KS beef, 2x Original Philly PA prepared; 2026: Lexington NE beef closed Jan 20 2026, Rome GA prepared closing May 31 2026). This site does not appear on it. Checked against agriculturedive.com, kcur.org and wrdw.com reporting; swept 2026-08-12.

fieldNotes.truckGate: Two controlled truck entrances, both off Jefferson St. (1) Main entrance at 36.18906,-94.12504 - the Tyson monument sign there reads MAIN/VISITOR ENTRANCE / SHIPPING; a staffed guard booth sits about 45 m inside the curb cut, directly in the truck path. (2) North entrance at 36.19158,-94.12400 - a black cantilever slide gate mounted on the fence line, photographed standing open in the 2025-03 pano. The whole property is enclosed by a continuous ornamental steel palisade fence, visible along Jefferson St in every pano sampled.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Confirmed visually, not inferred. 2025-03 Street View (pano RpjocBAe6Ri47BtrjfGzZg, heading 286, fov 25) shows a tan 1-story booth roughly 10 m x 5 m with windows on multiple faces, a covered entry and steps, and a golf cart parked beside it, sitting in the truck lane about 45 m inside the Jefferson St main entrance. Confirmed again on z21 satellite at 36.18910,-94.12544. It is not the main building.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - a physical staffed booth is present, so this is not a kiosk/call-box site.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: About 45 m of paved drive between the Jefferson St curb cut and the guard booth, wide enough to hold 2-3 tractor-trailers ahead of the checkpoint.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved holding area inside the booth (the ~0.95-acre internal drive/apron traced as `staging`) between the checkpoint and the dock faces.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Gate-to-dock run is roughly 180-200 m from the Jefferson St entrance north to the east-facing shipping docks; easily 3+ trucks of stacking.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: False. The curb cut opens immediately into a 2.8-acre paved drop yard, so a queue at the booth holds on-property rather than on Jefferson St.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Main curb cut measures roughly 13-15 m and is unstriped, so lane count is functional rather than marked; recorded as 1 in / 1 out. Low confidence.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Same unstriped curb cut; entry and exit share it.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: The entrance apron is unstriped and widens immediately into a large open yard - physical room exists to add a bypass/express lane past the booth without construction.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Medium confidence. Directly counted: about 14-16 enclosed freight dock positions on the east/southeast shipping face (8 trailers backed in at z20, plus a second bank of 5-6 north of it), and about 12-13 truck bays with regular rhythm along the southeast face of the northwest live-haul shed. Combined estimate 28 puts the site in 25-50. If live-haul receiving bays are excluded and only conventional freight docks counted, the band would be 10-25. This is a legacy multi-decade poultry complex, so additional docks may sit inside enclosed refrigerated structures and are not visible from overhead.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Three distinct trailer-parking areas traced. The south drop yard alone (2.8 acres, at 36.18885,-94.12557) held about 41 trailers parked around its perimeter in the current imagery; the two north-yard zones held about 38 more in angled rows. Well over 50.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Physically separate clusters: finished-goods shipping docks on the east/southeast face (the entrance sign literally routes SHIPPING to the Jefferson St gate), and raw/live-haul receiving on the northwest shed against the rail corridor, on the opposite side of the complex.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Urban. The plant sits inside Springdale's built fabric in the Fayetteville-Springdale-Rogers metro, bounded by E Huntsville Ave, Jefferson St, apartment complexes to the west and an employee lot across the street.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus. Distinct clusters: the main process/prepared-foods building mass, the east shipping/warehouse wing, the northwest live-haul shed, a north office/maintenance building, and an on-site wastewater treatment plant (clarifier plus a blue-domed digester).
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale deck or scale house found in either entrance path at z20/z21. Recorded false, medium confidence - a scale inside an enclosed dock area would not be visible.
fieldNotes.multiStep: No second checkpoint stage visible after the guard booth. Left false.
fieldNotes.railServed: Yes. The plant's entire west edge abuts the Arkansas and Missouri rail corridor, with sidings holding covered hoppers and tank cars alongside the process area and a covered rail unloading shed between tracks at roughly 36.19053,-94.12657. Note the corridor is shared and also carries stored/derelict cars, so the exact number of Tyson-served spurs is not fully separable from overhead.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: 16.0 acres, computed from the traced perimeter (64,700 sq m). Compact for a plant of this output - it is hemmed in by the rail corridor on the west and Jefferson St on the east. Perimeter accuracy roughly plus/minus 15 m on the west side where the fence line follows the irregular rail right-of-way.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Estimate. South drop yard 2.8 acres at perimeter-row layout with a maneuvering core is about 70-80 trailers; the two north drop zones (about 2 acres combined) about 50-60. Total 140, plus or minus 25.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Counted from the current satellite pass: about 41 in the south drop yard, about 38 across the north yard rows, about 8 backed into the east shipping docks, plus roughly 8 staged along the building faces. Total about 95, plus or minus 15.
